source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The test adds distinct messages before closing and reopening the database, before and after deletion, and before and after compaction URL completion. Existing assertions check the serialized size/count, summary validity, final file size and retained message key. Those trace boundaries help locate a stalled or failing phase, but adding them does not prove a fix. Bugzilla corrects an initial diagnosis and distinguishes lock failures from an out-of-date summary. No large-file runtime test was executed.
title: Large-mailbox trace points separate database reopen from compaction completion
